failure_story: Capital is committed near $26 on an inventory story that is real but slower than assumed. The 8,783 gross undeveloped locations exist and CG&A audited them, but conversion is entirely at third-party operators' discretion and they allocate rigs to their own best rock, not to WhiteHawk's royalty position. At the disclosed 126-198 wells/yr participation the inventory is a 35-58 year programme; if gas softens and Appalachian operators cut activity by a third, the pace that holds volumes flat disappears and the producing book reverts toward its 7.27-year PDP life. Meanwhile the mandatory hedging covenant, which protected the downside, also caps the recovery: the Note Purchase Agreement requires fixed-price swaps on 50-75% of PDP volumes rolling 36 months, so the gas-price upside the market is paying roughly +1.7% to +4.6% perpetual growth for is contractually sold forward for three years at a time. Holders discover the position is structurally a fixed-income instrument on a wasting asset with an equity multiple attached. Depletion, which already equals CAFD ($36.451m against $36.317m pro forma), keeps net income negative; the board, gated at 2.00x leverage for restricted payments, sets an initial dividend well below the CAFD headline; and the equity re-rates from roughly 2.7x PV-10 toward asset value.
earliest_warnings: The first 10-Q reports net production below the 64,270 Mcfe/d Q1 2026 run-rate without an offsetting acquisition, confirming conversion is not keeping pace with the 13.75% PDP decline.
Operator capital budgets for 2027 showing Appalachian and Haynesville activity down materially, since WhiteHawk's 18% new-well participation is derivative of their spending, not its own.
An initial declared dividend materially below the ~$1.30 per Class A share the pro forma CAFD run-rate implies, or a stated policy of retaining CAFD for acquisitions.
Realised prices lagging spot as the mandated swaps roll on at lower strikes than the prevailing strip.
The FY2026 reserve report carrying materially fewer than 8,783 gross undeveloped locations, or negative revisions to the 206,473 MMcfe proved book.
Any repeat internal-control finding, given the April 22, 2026 conclusion that FY2025 statements could not be relied upon.
forensic_checks: Reconcile CAFD to net cash provided by operating activities every period. Pro forma FY2025 operating cash flow was $9.533m against $36.317m of CAFD, and pro forma Q1 2026 operating cash flow was NEGATIVE $10.714m against $9.959m of CAFD. Establish which add-backs are genuinely non-recurring rather than recharacterised operating cost.

Test the $21.795m management-fee add-back. It is $6.2m Base plus $3.7m Dividend Incentive plus $13.6m Liquidity Incentive less $1.7m internal compensation. The Liquidity Incentive Fee is IPO-triggered and never recurs, so the durable saving from the Internalization is roughly $8.2m, not $21.8m -- against a $130.0m purchase price.

Read the actual swap schedule once filed: notional volumes, strikes and tenor. The covenant sets a floor of 50-75% of PDP but not the price, and the pro forma $16.052m derivative gain says the existing book is materially in the money at the old deck.
Compare depletion to CAFD every period. While DD&A approximates CAFD the distribution is return of capital and the payout ratio on economic earnings exceeds 100%.

Independently sample the 8,353 unbooked locations against operator permits and rig schedules. CG&A audited their existence, not the timing of their development, and timing is what the 0.10-0.25 realisation haircut is guessing at.
Trace the Up-C ownership arithmetic: the prospectus states IPO purchasers hold 24.8% of OpCo indirectly, while 33.5% of the Company times 86.0% is 28.8%. Those do not tie.

short_source_coverage.detail: The frozen adversarial pass records no Tier-1 forensic short and no local short_reports/, and the third-party cross-check still indexes zero sources. Two months after IPO that is expected, but it means no independent adversarial party has examined this name and the absence of a short thesis carries no information.

unresolved_items: No 10-Q or 10-K has been filed since the 2026-06-10 IPO, so every operating figure remains pro forma and the swap book's actual strikes and tenor are unknown.
No dividend has been declared as a public company, though 49 consecutive monthly dividends totalling ~$37m were paid pre-IPO on the predecessor share classes.

The gas price deck is frozen at the SEC trailing $3.387/MMBtu in every case; no forward strip is in the packet, and for an entity whose revenue is near-linear in price with no cost offset that is the largest unpriced variable.
Operator drilling schedules, which determine the conversion pace the entire inventory component depends on, are third-party data absent from the filing.
No comparable-transaction evidence exists for Appalachian mineral packages, so the market's ~2.7x PV-10 multiple cannot be judged normal or rich.
Remediation status of the identified material weaknesses is not established.
